video_title: Channing Breaks Down the REAL Reason Portland Saves Ja Morant

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on Ja Morant's injury history and play style
quotes.excerpt: If you play hard and you go fucking hard, you should be hurt.
quotes.quote: I understand the off-the-court stuff. I also understand being hurt in this league because if you play hard and you go fucking hard, you should be hurt. Every once in a while you are going to get hurt. You are going to turn an ankle, you are going to pull a hammy. That boy plays hard and he does hyper-athletic shit. I would totally expect some soft tissue injuries to happen to Ja Morant. I don't know what the shock is.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on Ja Morant's fit with Damian Lillard in Portland
quotes.excerpt: Now it's a Damian Lillard standard that he's going to say, you know, you can't shoot jumpers.
quotes.quote: Ja Morant as a young player had to set the standard at Memphis and he made a lot of mistakes. There was no real vet over top of him to be like, yo young fella. You say Mike Conley at times, but that really wasn't it. But now it's a Damian Lillard standard that he's going to say, you know, you can't shoot jumpers. Well now you have him with one of the better shooting guards of all time. Then you look at the culture of what Ja Morant likes and what Damian Lillard lives. Damian Lillard is in that studio. Damian Lillard lives that rap life, but he does it in a way that where the main thing is the main thing.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on Ja Morant's shoe brand and marketability
quotes.excerpt: Ja Morant I think has the second highest selling shoe for Nike.
quotes.quote: Ja Morant I think has the second highest selling shoe for Nike. Nike said, hold on, you are an Adidas bro, what are you talking about? I wear whatever I want. I don't have a contract with anybody.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the synergy between Damian Lillard, Ja Morant, and Drew Holiday
quotes.excerpt: If you have Dame on the court, you can have Drew. If you have Ja on the court.
quotes.quote: If you have Dame on the court, you can have Drew. If you have Ja on the court, you can have Drew. So he is kind of like that, he is that, if Drew is not there, you are shopping Drew and you get caught in the LeBron, Kyrie thing. Remember how LeBron and Kyrie were stars together, but you had to take one out early so the other one could kind of get in the rhythm. They are both ball-handling guys. They both need the ball. You can't take Ja's rhythm away completely, but that's the only way Dame could get off.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Ja Morant's need to earn his starting role
quotes.excerpt: I think that Ja minutes is going to have to be earned, not given.
quotes.quote: I think that Ja minutes is going to have to be earned, not given. He is not going to be given a starting role over there in Portland. I mean, this team just went to the playoffs. Yeah, they traded Jeremy Grant, we got that part, but Scoot Henderson balled out. He is still over there, a guy that they drafted with the lottery pick. Drew Holiday, if he doesn't get traded, that's a real conversation. Drew Holiday is making some real good money, and Dame coming off an Achilles injury. I hope Ja goes over there and listens to Dame. I hope Ja goes over there and accepts all the knowledge.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Coach Chauncey Billups' challenge in Portland
quotes.excerpt: Coach Chauncey Billups, he has his hands full as a one-year coach on a one-year deal.
quotes.quote: Coach Chauncey Billups, he has his hands full as a one-year coach on a one-year deal. A one-year coach on a one-year deal with that new owner, to me nobody is safe.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the risks of one-year coaching contracts
quotes.excerpt: That's also not a formula for success. That's not a formula success.
quotes.quote: Agreed, agreed. Agreed. But that's also not a formula for success. That's not a formula success. If you walk in, and all of a sudden it's like you're not my real daddy. When you got a one-year head coach, that's an interim head coach. You are going to listen to him? You are going to be invested? How invested are you going to be? That to me is not a formula for success inside of a locker room when you don't have that level. The organization gave you a one-year deal, why am I supposed to listen to you? And I love Mica. I believe that he will get the players' attention. I believe he will do the things that are needed.
